title: Binge-Watch Marathon Sessions
dataSources: Tautulli/Plex playback (`tautulli:play`), Jellyfin activity (`jellyfin:activity`), Spotify recently-played (`spotify:play`), Steam player and achievements (`steam:player`), Sonarr events (`sonarr:event`).
app: Plex / Jellyfin (Tautulli), Sonos, Spotify, Steam, Xbox/PSN, and the *arr stack (Sonarr/Radarr) APIs and webhooks via HEC scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=tautulli:play
| bin _time span=1d
| stats sum(duration_s) as secs, count as plays by user _time
| eval hours=round(secs/3600,1)
| where hours>=6
| sort - hours
description: Finds those all-day or all-night media marathons so you can laugh at them, learn from them, or maybe avoid scheduling them before workdays.
value: Long sessions are not inherently bad, but they are exactly the kind of pattern memory smooths over; telemetry preserves the truth.
implementation: Forward playback duration from Tautulli or Jellyfin; review daily totals and optionally tie big spikes to sleep or productivity dashboards.
visualization: Daily bar chart of watch-hours by user.
grandmaExplanation: It checks when a normal evening of watching turns into a full-on six-hour marathon without you noticing.
